stem.en: A made-up stock of fish starts at 100 thousand. Each year it grows by 30%, and then the catch is taken out. If the catch is 30 thousand a year, what is the stock at the end of the first year, in thousands of fish?

explanation.en: The stock grows first and the catch comes after. 100 thousand grows by 30% to 130 thousand, and taking out 30 thousand leaves 100 thousand again. Stopping at the growth gives 130, which is not the end of the year.

hints.en: Work out the growth first, then take away the catch.
30% of 100 is 30, so the stock grows to 130 thousand before the catch.
